selection.single: Plain row/title activation replaces selection and sets anchor
selection.range: Shift activation replaces selection with inclusive contiguous visible interval; no Ctrl/Cmd additive selection or row checkboxes
selection.drag: Dragging a row/title past six pixels moves the selected range if the source belongs to it; otherwise moves that one row. Interactive mutation controls are excluded. Touch grip remains available. Click after a completed drag is suppressed.

dates.due: Native datetime-local picker; explicit client-zone conversion to UTC. Empty clears. Nonexistent/ambiguous DST time reports a recoverable input error without writing.
dates.defer: Native date picker keeps explicit client timezone and 09:00 domain resolution; datetime-local is converted to a UTC instant. Saved instants are displayed in client zone without writing on render.

catalog.locations: Projects/Tags navigation plus selected-action classification controls
catalog.flow: Plus exposes inline name and Create. Existing project_get_or_create/tag_get_or_create freezes name and operation ID; result.resolved.project/tag supplies the server UUID. Creation is one catalog write. Optional assignment follows full snapshot acceptance as a separate versioned autosave only when the captured classification still matches; never claimed atomic.

retention: Original action context and name retained through unknown/recovery/navigation; subsequent edits preserved; serial owner lane and explicit current write gates remain.
